title: 'She Is a Doctor' Came Back as 'He'. Why?
topic: Turkish and Hungarian have one word for he/she; old Google Translate guessed from its training text, where doctors were mostly 'he'. Google added both versions in 2018.
audience: Everyday phone/PC/internet/game/AI-chat users who have seen this themselves
whyCare: Translate memes pull millions; the gender-guess quirk is checkable and unexplained in Shorts.
